title: The System note file
description: Schema for the flat JSON note files stored in the data folder. A conforming file matches exactly one of the note shapes this app currently reads and writes: art, milestone, activity, flashcard, or prompt.

rels.description: Relationships to other note files: [label, filename] or [label, filename, mirrorLabel] — the optional third element records the reciprocal label written on the related note.

triaged.description: Written by the triage flows once a note has been kept.

extraData.description: Arbitrary nested props imported from Obsidian frontmatter (see the "Add props from Obsidian" action on a note's view screen), preserved as-is. Not otherwise read or written by the app.

oneOf.description: Milestone notes: a status marker (open, failed, or soso) with a free-text description.

logs.description: Timestamped free-text log entries kept directly on the milestone, newest first in the UI regardless of array order. Added/removed via the milestone's Logs section.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp stamped automatically when the entry is added.

oneOf.description: Activity notes: a logged activity worth keeping track of.
Flashcard notes: a front/back pair reviewed by the Memorize flow using FSRS spaced-repetition scheduling.

fsrs.description: Serialized fsrs.Card learning data (see lib/services/fsrs_service.dart), absent until the card is first practiced in the Memorize flow.

oneOf.description: Prompt notes: a free-text question re-asked on a fixed day interval, answered via the Prompts flow.

interval.description: Days between re-asking this prompt. Parsed leniently by lib/services/prompt_service.dart; missing/invalid treated as 1.

lastShownAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last recorded answer, stamped by the Prompts flow. Absent until first answered.

answers.description: Timestamped free-text answers recorded by the Prompts flow, newest first in the UI regardless of array order.
